name: Perceval Discord backend
purpose: Decide the next state of the Discord backend's fetch from the state it is in and the last API response: request the channel, page through its messages, finish, refuse a response that breaks the contract, or fail. Send state, response, returned, limit, remaining, floor or sleep, separated by spaces; it answers channel, paging, done, refused or failed, and invalid request for anything else.
inputLabel: Request: state response returned limit remaining floor sleep

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: PD-01: the app never answers paging when response is foreign. PD-02: the app never answers paging when response is stale. PD-03: the app never answers paging when returned is above limit. PD-04: the app never answers paging when remaining is at most floor and sleep is no. PD-05: the app never answers done when state is channel. PD-06: the app always answers failed when response is error and state is not done and state is not refused. PD-07: the app always answers done when state is done. PD-08: the app always answers refused when state is refused. PD-09: the app always answers failed when state is failed.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  state is done → done
  state is refused → refused
  state is failed → failed
  response is foreign → refused
  response is stale → refused
  response is error → failed
  returned is above limit → refused
  state is paging and returned is below limit → done
  remaining is at most floor and sleep is no → failed
  otherwise → paging
proposition.plain: Decide the next state of the Discord backend's fetch from the state it is in and the last API response: request the channel, page through its messages, finish, refuse a response that breaks the contract, or fail.
